name: Ambroxol
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Ambroxol is cleared mainly by the liver (glucuronidation and CYP3A4), but its metabolites are excreted in urine and are expected to accumulate in severe kidney impairment. European-derived labels give no numeric adjustment; they advise caution with lower doses or longer intervals. It has no US FDA label.
kidney_function_basis: The SmPCs grade kidney impairment only in words ('impaired', 'severe'); bands shown on creatinine clearance (CrCl).

bands.recommendation: Usual adult oral dose: 30 mg three times daily (90 mg/day) for 2 to 3 days, then 30 mg twice daily (60 mg/day); up to 60 mg twice daily (120 mg/day) for greater effect (syrup SmPC).

Kidney impairment: no numeric adjustment is given; use with caution, for example with lower doses or longer dosing intervals; liver-generated metabolites are expected to accumulate in severe kidney impairment (SmPC 4.2, 4.4).

hd.text: No dialysis data. Metabolites expected to accumulate; if used, lower dose or longer interval (SmPC wording for severe kidney impairment).

pd.text: No data. Use with caution at reduced dose or interval.

monitoring: Stop at once if a progressive rash appears, with or without blisters or mucosal lesions (erythema multiforme, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis) (SmPC 4.4).

pediatric.approved_ages: Syrup: 2 years and older; contraindicated under 2 years. Lozenges: not under 12 years (SmPC).
pediatric.usual_dose: 2 to 5 years: 7.5 mg three times daily (22.5 mg/day); 6 to 12 years: 30 to 45 mg/day in 2 or 3 divided doses; over 12 years: adult dose (syrup SmPC).

renal.recommendation: Normal kidney function: usual pediatric doses by age (syrup SmPC).

adult: Oral dose source is a Thai FDA SmPC template that reproduces the HPRA ambroxol syrup SmPC (August 2016); the HPRA original syrup SmPC was not retrieved. PH products are mainly 30 mg tablets, syrups and 75 mg modified-release capsules; MR dosing not covered.
Amber for all bands below 60 because the SmPC advises lower doses or longer intervals without numbers (judgment).
Pediatric 2–5 years: SmPC states 22.5 mg/day divided three times daily; written here as 7.5 mg three times daily (arithmetic).
